title: Characteristic-rank loci of an etale log structure
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $M$ an etale log structure on $X$ [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. For $r\in\mathbf N\cup\{\infty\}$ define the characteristic-rank locus $X_M(r)$ to be the set of points $x\in X$ such that for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ and geometric point $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ with image $x$, the group completion of $\overline M_t$ has rational rank $r$. Here rank is the rational dimension of $\mathbf Q\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\overline M_t^{\mathrm{gp}}$, expressed in $\mathbf N\cup\{\infty\}$, as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Equip this locus with the subspace topology inherited from $X$.

source.place: VI 1.2,1.5; VIII 3.4.11, printed p.112; VIII 5.5.2, last paragraph of printed p.128.
